## Type
- [ ] **New mosque** — not yet in the list
- [ ] **Data correction** — fix or update an existing mosque

## Mosque name and location
- **Name:** (e.g. Sultan Ahmed Mosque)
- **City / location:**
- **Country:**

## What to add or change
For **new mosque:** briefly describe what you know (capacity, year built, significance, visitor access).  
For **correction:** say what’s wrong and what it should be (with a source if possible).

## Source(s)
Link to at least one source (Wikipedia, official site, news, etc.) so we can fact-check.
- 

## Optional
- Image URL (prefer Wikimedia Commons or official, free-to-use)
- Coordinates (lat/lng) if you have them
- Tourist-friendly? Women’s prayer area?

---
**Tip:** The in-app [Contribute](https://mosquelist.com/contributing) page has the full JSON schema and a form that generates mosque data. You can paste the generated JSON in a comment here or open a Pull Request.
